title: The inverse-frequency estimate holds on the whole fast subspace
statement: For a periodic one-spin path with arbitrary real integrable longitudinal field f,a zero-mean temporal test g and periodic primitive G give Var_f(integral g sigma)<=4integral|Gg|<=4||G||2||g||2. For Q_K excluding frequencies belowOmega=2pi(K+1)/beta,this gives Q_K C_f Q_K<=(4/Omega)Q_K on the ENTIRE common fast subspace. Same-field replica exchange cancels longitudinal weights; disagreement interval orientations plus occupancy<=1/2 earn the constant. On a finite cycle,simultaneous flips require the zero-field FK interval-cluster repair; discrete Fourier step embeddings preserve the frequency congruence/alias exclusion. The earlier conditional inverse-square proposal remains false and the forced-field example makes inverse-frequency order sharp. This is the supplied analytic whole-subspace theorem,not extrapolation from434exact configurations/30finite covariance tests; established replica ancestry is credited.
